title: Strange message colors when sensor age exceeds 10 days
body:
### Discussed in https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/discussions/2985
Originally posted by **ANDREAPIPPI** August 4, 2023 AAs shownn in the image, the message "Ends in 13.6 days" has white text on a black background, but when the age goes past 10 days, the message changes to "Expires Sun, 3:58pm", in terrible white text on a cream background, which turns out to be almost illegible. Is this the rule or have I chosen wrong colors in the settings? I searched but couldn't find my mistake. Thank you. Andrew :-) ![strange-colors](https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/assets/32884006/cf6f9da5-8ad8-4a20-8a52-710b3a9539d3)

comments.body: What is the hardware data source?
It's a FSL 2 14 days Europe, used Direct under OOP2 Algorythm, but the same problem occurred with a FSL 1 14 days Europe with MiaoMiao 1, too....

Hi.
I just found that this was a problem caused by my phone's MIUI 14 OS, just like the strange color settings problem in discussion #3176, i.e. if the screen display setting is "Dark", problems exist, if "Clear" all is OK.

![All OK](https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/assets/32884006/0ec30e3b-ccc8-4f3f-b9b7-97a5dc8b18a8)

I need to change my phone with a "real" Android one, alas!
Sorry for troubling and for the time wasted, I apologize.    :-(

No problem.
Thanks for the feedback.
So, I hope it is OK that I close this then.  We can reopen if needed of course.
